newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria's Kaduna refinery gets new chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's Kaduna refinery gets new chief executive.

text.p: Nigeria's military government has appointed a new chief executive for the northern Kaduna Refining and Petrochemical Company, the state news agency said on Friday.
Morris Tamuno replaces the refinery's former managing director, Abubakar Yar Adua, the News Agency of Nigeria reported, adding that Tamuno had assumed duties.
Until his new appointment, Tamuno was director of operations at the southeastern Port Harcourt refinery, the agency said.
The agency did not give reasons for the replacement.
Local newspapers quoting oil ministry sources last week reported that Yar Adua had been sacked effective immediately but the reason for the action was not clear.
